info.title: VTDD Butler Action API
info.description: Canonical OpenAPI template for a user-owned VTDD Butler surface.

get.summary: Check whether the VTDD worker is reachable.

post.summary: Evaluate VTDD policy, repository candidates, and Butler guidance.

422.description: Request blocked by policy or validation

post.summary: Dispatch bounded VTDD execution, including remote Codex handoff.
Execute scoped normal-tier GitHub write operations through VTDD.

responseMode.description: Use action_visible from Custom GPT so write failures return ok:false JSON instead of an Action transport failure.

naturalApproval.description: Evidence for normal GitHub write natural GO binding after Butler showed the exact payload and the user replied with GO. Supported natural GO operations include issue_create, issue_comment_create, and pull_comment_create.

200.description: GitHub normal write executed, or an action-visible ok:false envelope when responseMode is action_visible.

422.description: GitHub write request blocked or invalid

post.summary: Persist a structured VTDD operational memory candidate after Butler shows it and receives GO.

confirmed.description: True only after Butler shows the structured memory candidate and the human replies GO.

ownerConsent.description: Optional natural GO evidence. Do not ask the human for raw JSON.

responseMode.description: Use action_visible from Custom GPT so memory write failures return ok:false JSON instead of an Action transport failure.

post.summary: Execute approval-bound GitHub authority actions that require GO plus real passkey.

422.description: GitHub authority action blocked or invalid

post.summary: Dispatch governed production deploy after GO plus real passkey approval.
Sync an approved GitHub Actions secret such as OPENAI_API_KEY after GO plus real passkey approval.

422.description: GitHub Actions secret sync request blocked or invalid

post.summary: Save or update a user-defined repository nickname in the VTDD alias registry.

422.description: Repository nickname request blocked or invalid

post.summary: Delete an explicit user-defined repository nickname from the VTDD alias registry.

repository.description: Canonical owner/repo target for the nickname entry.

nickname.description: Exact nickname or alias to delete from the target repository entry.

404.description: Repository nickname delete target not found

422.description: Repository nickname delete request blocked or invalid

get.summary: Read progress for a remote Codex execution request.
Read explicit VPS runner health and status for a bounded execution.

200.description: VPS runner health/status and matching execution progress

post.summary: Cancel or drain VPS runner queue comments through GitHub-visible runtime truth.

issueNumber.description: Required for mode=issue_pending; optional scope hint for mode=execution.

200.description: VPS runner cancellation marker write result
